recipes.name: Creamy Cheesy Scrambled Eggs with Basil

steps.text: Whisk together eggs and sour cream in a large bowl until creamy and smooth. Mix in cheese. Season with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Pour in egg mixture; cook, stirring constantly, until eggs reach desired consistency. Mix in basil during final minutes of cooking.

raw_recipe.headline: Creamy Cheesy Scrambled Eggs with Basil
raw_recipe.description: These cheesy scrambled eggs with sour cream, mozzarella, and basil are rich and satisfying. Serve with toast and fresh fruit for a divine breakfast.
raw_recipe.name: Creamy Cheesy Scrambled Eggs with Basil

review.reviewBody: You're right on using sour cream in eggs. It is a great dairy item to use even without the cheese. This is a great variation on a brilliant theme. My favorite is chive but any herb will do just great. ENJOY!

I did a few different things in this recipe, but I believe I got an excellent result nonetheless. Instead of sour cream, I used plain nonfat yogurt, and while mozzarella is a good cheese, I find it rather bland, so I used feta instead. I also used cilantro instead of basil. In the oven, I par cooked some hash browns with bits of onion, red pepper, and minced garlic. I then added the egg and yogurt mixture and cooked that the rest of the way. Upon removing from the oven, I sprinkled the feta all around, and then topped with cilantro.

wanted a recipe for a breakfast group that would need to stay warm and not dried out and this worked great. The freshly grated cheese - I used gouda - and the room temp sour cream (added to warm large saute pan with heat off) kept this dish warm and creamy. Used my large cast iron because cheese would stick otherwise and to retain heat. Used my garden basil more as a garnish but also my garden cilantro would be a nice taste

I often use creme fraiche or a click of spread cream cheese like Philadelphia or Creme Bonjour in my scrambled eggs. It makes beautiful colour on the food. 
Just noticed that in most of the pictures the food was way overcooked. Scrambled eggs is not supposed to be dry but creamy and fluffy. Take the pan off the heat before the food is done!

this recipe is on the right track, but the eggs should be cooked at at a medium low heat and the sour cream should be added near the end of the cooking time, just before plating. otherwise, there is a good chance the eggs will be overdone. try this with chives!

Lovely, tasty and easy as pie to make! I did not have any mozzarella around so I used a tbsp or two on grated locatelli Romano cheese I did have. Used 2% Greek yogurt instead of sour cream for the extra protein and added the basil towards the end of cooking, as recommended. Next time, will use the mozzarella because it will add a bit of sweetness and gooey texture. Thanks for the recipe!!
Yum! These were good! I used less cheese, and mixed half of it in the egg mixture, and sprinkled the rest in as it cooked. My family loved it.

Because I am a single person, I halved the recipe. The eggs vere delicious but not creamy. I slowly sauted onion and garlic prior to adding the eggs and pepper jack cheese with the sour cream and basil, salt and pepper. My analysis of the eggs not being creamy are possibly (as others have mentioned) the sour cream not being added at the end or because I scrambled the eggs too long. At any rate I'll make this recipe again and add the sour cream at the end and maybe not cook the eggs as long.
Loved i I added minced garlic and onions as well with Extra fresh Basil! Delish!!

This was a great recipe for scrambled eggs! I used milk instead of sour cream, and I sliced some country style skinless pork sausages and added them when the eggs were partially firmed. I also chopped up some fresh chives from my garden and added them with the basil, which was also fresh. At the end I sprinkled more mozzarella on top of the eggs once the were cooked and let it melt. I served it with green grapes, toast, and yellow cherry tomatoes. My whole family LOVED it and said that I should make it all the time.

I never added sour cream to scrambled eggs but Hubs and I found we enjoyed it. Since there was already mozzarella and fresh basil going on here I added halved grape tomatoes, instantly creating "Eggs Caprese." If you like Caprese salad, you'll like these eggs too. Nice.
I followed recipe exactly as written. I loved it. I had been bored with my plain scrambled eggs and thus was a welcome change.
I was surprised how good this is!!
I made half the recipe just for me and it was yummy! It was a little too much for me along with blueberries and toast but for bigger eaters- perfect! No changes!
So delicious! Sauted yellow squash, zucchini and red onion.
Excellent. Creamy and tasty.
Made as directed- delicious! Next I will try will some garlic powder or pesto as others have suggested.

I really like this recipe and will keep using it. I used fat-free sour cream and it turned out very well. I served it with lightly buttered toast and fresh fruit. What a great breakfast! But this could also be a quick fix for dinner!
I'm not a huge scrambled egg fan; I usually have to douse them in hot sauce or salsa. This is the first recipe for them I've found that I don't have to add anything to... delicious!
Good! Easy& flavorful!
